summary: D04 keeps 24 of its 41 nodes unchanged, rewires 14 (causal prerequisite repairs; two of them also re-scored), splits two (one also rewired), relocates one, and adds nine nodes. Splits separate discovery from later theory or method where consumers differ: electromagnetism (experimental laws, key kept) / electromagnetic field theory, and genome_sequencing (genomics, key kept) / DNA sequencing - halving the subtree's largest single wait. Seven new nodes fill foundations the subtree lacked, each with an in-lane dependant: thermodynamics, spectroscopy, periodic system, organic chemistry, cell theory, biological classification, and probability and statistics. Non-causal edges are removed (astrolabe <- gearing, sulphuric_acid <- lead glass, haber_bosch <- electricity_generation, atomic_clock <- longitude_problem, petroleum_refining <- mining_shaft, genetics_mendel <- evolution) and dna_structure now needs xray. Costs move only with content: astrolabe -79 % (institutional outlier, one requirement), quantum_mechanics +41 % (four prerequisites; institutional to the A9 prior), evolution and synthetic_dye +41 % and petroleum_refining -29 % (prerequisite-complexity convention). double_entry moves to the trunk beside bill_of_exchange (with D05). Dead ends get dependants (pcr, corned_powder, soda_leblanc via D09/D02, relativity via D08's gps) or later owners (M9 public health for chlorine; M10+ for explosives, emissions); space_telescope stays a justified knowledge-only leaf. Requests from D01, D02, D03, D05, D06, D07, D08, D09, D10 and D12 are answered. Everything here is PROPOSED.

One requirement: prereq_complexity 0.5 -> 0.0.
existing.rationale: Kept as the instrument node (time, latitude, surveying; feeds celestial_navigation and the observatory entity). Two content corrections: the gearing edge is not knowledge the instrument needs, and its institutional score 3.0 is the corpus maximum, otherwise used only by state- or corporation-scale A9 programmes (no other A6 node exceeds 1.75); the astrolabe was a portable instrument made by individual craftsman-scholars (oldest dated survivor: Nastulus, 927/928 CE - RESEARCHED). Content re-score, not pacing.
